NOTICE FROM THE CLERK
NO. 12-06
Increases to the Miscellaneous Fee Schedule Effective June 1, 2012
The Judicial Conference has approved minor changes to the miscellaneous fee
schedule for the district courts. See, 28 U.S.C. § 1914(b). As a result, the following
fees have been increased:
e For exemplification of any document, from $18 to $21
e For conducting a search of the district court records (per name or item
searched),' from $26 to $30
These changes will become effective on June 1, 2012.
In San Juan, Puerto Rico, this 19" day of April, d-
FRANCES RIOS DE MORAN, ESQ.
CLERK OF COURT
' This fee applies to services rendered on behalf of the United States if the information requested
is available through electronic access.
